analysis: Reviewer requested post hoc learned fusion diagnosis and controlled probability combinations
status: locked before first new control run
roles: Use original fit, early_stop, meta_fit, calibration (threshold selection), test; no reallocation
fit_weighting: Within each fitting subset, inverse source group size normalized to mean 1, as in original VAT-LR
control_1: One monotone sigmoid expit(a*p+b), a>=0, per branch; weighted log loss fit only on meta_fit. Text sigmoid fits only available-extraction rows; no-extraction text remains exactly 0.5. Equal arithmetic mean after calibration. No hyperparameter search.
control_2: Nonnegative linear probability pool; three weights sum to 1; weighted Brier objective on meta_fit; uniform start included; SLSQP ftol 1e-12 maxiter 2000, analytic gradient; no intercept. Applied to raw branch probabilities.
thresholds: Original grid 0.100 through 0.900 by 0.025. Maximize window Macro F1 on original calibration role. Ties nearest 0.5 then smaller threshold. Also report fixed 0.5.
evaluation: Window-weighted Brier, positive-class ECE with 10 equal-width bins, ROC-AUC, AP, accuracy, Macro F1; test pooled and test-size-weighted within-fold ECE. Also group-weighted loss and positive prevalence as diagnostics. Meta-fit scores for fitted combiners and calibrators are apparent fitting scores.
constraints: No test label used for fitting, calibrator selection, weight selection or threshold selection; no claim of guaranteed test improvement; descriptive seed42 analysis only.
scope: B3 B4 and Reviewer2 point3 only. No new encoder training, no edits to original predictions.
